Package neqsim.process.logic.procedure

Class OperatingProcedure

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.logic.procedure.OperatingProcedure
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ProcessLogic
public final class OperatingProcedure extends Object implements ProcessLogic
Executes an ordered operating procedure with physical feedback and timestamped evidence.

A step can be automatic or require an explicit operator authorization. The action issues a command, while a separate condition reads measured completion. Step prerequisites, timeout, first-out failure, optional recovery action and alarm text are retained in the execution record. The process model remains responsible for advancing physical equipment between procedure scans.

1.0
